programme.desc: Bodybuilder and striper Biggie can see into people's past lives. He meets rookie cop Yee and help her track down criminals. Yee decides to help him back while Biggie decides to......

programme.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish / 猶瑟與虎魚們
programme.desc: A fateful encounter between average college student Tsuneo and a wheelchair-bound dreamer, Josee, who spends her time reading and painting. As Tsuneo is swept up by her dreams, Josee takes another chance at facing reality.

programme.title: Band Four / 4拍4家族
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E279 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第279集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Paws-Men / 毛俠
programme.desc: The Paws-Men are Tat Yan, Charlie, Seal, and Keith. When a dog is in need of rescue, the Paws-Men assemble to save the dog immediately like Batman. ”Paws-Men” tells the story of rescuing dogs, in which Paws-Men encounter many difficulties, such as a dog eatery, bullies and a dog abusing granny. Yet Paws-Men witness true friendships between dogs and humans. This film makes us realize: Saving dogs is not hard. People are the real problem.

programme.title: Manhole / 小心陷井
programme.desc: Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.

programme.title: The Rising Star -Tang Lai Ying / 我要做接班人 -鄧麗英
programme.desc: Tang Lai Ying, known as “All-bad-angles pretty girl”, played a club girl-wannabe waitress in the film “Night King” and her comedic performance has won the audience's favor. Despite her cheerful and optimistic personality both on and off screen, she has experienced confusion on her journey to pursue her dreams. Despite of the popularity of her comedic image, she also longs for audiences to see her serious side. In this programme, Lai Ying is going to share her philosophy on happiness, giving everyone a glimpse of her most authentic self.

programme.title: Book of Love / 北京遇上西雅圖之不二情書
programme.desc: Jiao Ye moved to Macau with her father when she was 15. She is a sassy casino worker who longs for love, but her life was hard. Daniel, a commitment-averse real estate agent in Los Angeles who specializes in selling properties to wealthy man and father of a teenage son. Love blooms between the two as they start exchanging letters because of a book, they sharing their most personal and intimate self with each other.

programme.title: Miss Fortune / 欺詐女王
programme.desc: Ji-hye is a once-successful and beautiful swindler, who recently begins failing with her cons and dreams of changing her small-job life. Before her retirement, she decides to take on one last job which could change her whole life: seducing the son of a wealthy art broker family to steal the golden treasure hidden in their secret mansion. With the help of her daughter Ju-young, she succeeds in earning the trust of the family but it turns out to be a never-ending battle. Can Ji-hye and Ju-young find the legendary treasure and start a new life?

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E287 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第287集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: What Women Want / 我知女人心
programme.desc: Sun is not exactly the ideal husband, father or son, but family takes the backseat against career. As the top brass of the leading ad agency, his mind is only fixed on being promoted to the executive creative director post. But the announcement comes and Sun is beaten by a new colleague Ly, renowned as the Iron Lady in the ad industry. The boss believes Ly would bring a competitive edge for the agency - the female perspective. Sun and Ly are at loggerheads at first sight, and she gives him an assignment - takes home a box of female hygiene products, and present an ad idea the next morning. That night, Sun is brainstorming in the bathtub when he accidentally drops a lamp in the water. The electric shock knocks him out, and when he wakes up in the hospital, he realizes he has a new gift - he can really hear what women think! By listening to the inner thoughts of the opposite sex, Sun quickly wins the hearts and trust of all women...

programme.title: Don't Call It Mystery / 勿說是推理
programme.desc: One day, a talkative college student with a natural perm, Totonou Kunou visits Hiroshima for an art exhibition, and there meets a teenage girl, Shioji Kariatsumari, who says she is a friend of Garo Inudo. “Would you work for me? Lives and money are at stake. I'm serious.” She offers Totonou a part-time job, which turns out to be related to the succession of an enormous inheritance. Totonou decides to help her out, only to get involved in an inheritance battle of the noble and shady Kariatsumari family, where people have been killed for generations. Multiple dark sides and mysteries of the family are laid out behind the inheritance. What truth is buried there?

programme.title: Overheard 3 / 竊聽風雲3
programme.desc: Five Years ago, LAW was jailed for killing a major land owner in a car accident. At that time LAW worked as a chauffeur for the rural tycoon LUK. It was rumored that LUK was behind such land owner's death, which gave LUK a competitive edge in the native apartment development deal. Before the Hong Kong handover in 1997, every native, male resident in the New Territories was granted the right to build a house. Yet it had caused social unrest over the land right, until recently the government decided to gather all of the remaining land rights from these residents and plan to build taller apartment buildings. LUK wished to swallow the enormous project and this started the fights between LUK, the land owner and other real estate developers. When LAW gets out of prison five years later, the world has changed...

programme.title: Good Game / 觸電
programme.desc: The middle-aged Boss Tai owns an Internet cafe that has long since lost popularity; Bond, an e-sports player who is not yet in his thirties, is facing a career dilemma of declining strength; Fey grew up in a single-parent family, and she has been unemployed for more than five years since she graduated from college; The former action star Ba Ye, because his wife Ah Lan suffered from brain degeneration, the two over 70 years old tried to use video games to exercise their brains. Seeing a solicitation for a Hong Kong e-sports competition led Boss Tai, who wanted to save the Internet cafe, to form a team. Boss Tai, Fey, and Ba Ye, three rookies plus a young master, Bond, who is eager to prove himself, officially established the Happy Hour e-sports team. Family and friendship turned into a battle in the e-sports arena, an impossible battle that stopped them from regretting their dreams.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E154 -The Eight Hundred / 爆谷電影現場 第154集 -八佰
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Eight Hundred / 八佰
programme.desc: The film is based on true stories taking place during Sino-Japanese war in Shanghai, China, in 1937, the battle and protection of the Si Hang Warehouse. There are around 400 soldiers (so called Eight Hundred Heroes in history), holding out against numerous waves of Japanese forces for 4 days and 4 nights...

programme.title: Midnight Swan / 午夜天鵝
programme.desc: Nagisa is transgender. She grew up in Hiroshima as a man, but now lives in Shinjuku, Tokyo as a woman. Due to an incident, she begins to live with middle school student Ichika, who is a distant relative. Ichika has been neglected by her mother Saori. From living in solitude by herself, to now living with Ichika, Nagisa develops maternal instincts for the first time.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E225 -Troll Factory / 爆谷電影現場 第225集 -網戰特攻隊
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Troll Factory / 網戰特攻隊
programme.desc: Talented yet arrogant city desk journalist Lim Sang-jin investigates corruption within the major corporation Manjun, only to have his report debunked as a hoax, leading to his integrity being questioned. “Your article wasn't false. It was a trick that we orchestrated” Then one day, a suspicious tip is sent to Lim. The mysterious whistleblower introduces himself as a member of the online opinion manipulation team known as Team Alep, which fabricated both truth and lies for the right price...Where does the truth begin and the lie end?

programme.title: The Way We Talk / 看我今天怎麼說
programme.desc: Wolf, born into a Deaf family, embraces sign language with confidence despite obstacles in life; Sophie, having a cochlear implant at a young age, continuously strives to be seen as 'normal', despite struggling with oral language. Alan, with a cochlear implant like Sophie, is capable of both oral and sign language; he advocates for diverse modes of communication within the deaf community. Bound by love and friendship, the three embark on a self-discovering journey with their own moments of pain.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Leap / 奪冠
programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes?

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Tse Kwan Ho: Night King / 爆谷巨星匯：謝君豪: 夜王
programme.desc: The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club's manager, Foon, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make things worse for Foon, the club's new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good. To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E288 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第288集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: La Brassiere / 絕世好Bra
programme.desc: Samantha, the president of a renowned brassiere company, breaks the tradition and hires two guys, Johnny and Wayne, as brassiere designers, and requires them to submit novel design in 3 months. Lena, is discontent with this decision deliberately make things difficult for them, those two newcomers to the brassiere industry thus act like buffoon. The time is coming. Can those two guys really work out the 'Ultimate Bra'?

programme.title: Dearest Anita / 朝花夕拾．芳華絕代
programme.desc: 2013, after the auction of items from Anita's estate, seemingly insignificant items are transported to a garbage dump. A number of fans try to salvage what they can in the dead of night. Undeterred by the conditions or the imminent threat of arrest, they work meticulously to save each of these treasures. Handwritten cards, letters and small hand-crafted gifts from fans, some even forgotten by the people who originally made them, every single one of these seemingly insignificant items kept and lovingly treasured by Anita over the years. Not wanting Anita's treasures to be condemned to landfills, these fans save and endeavour to return each of these to their original owner. Through their journey back to their original owner, we trace the stories of several fans whose lives were touched and forever changed by their chance encounters with their idol. Stories of: Growing confidence, Inspiration, Courage, Rekindled faith in people, and Friendship. Life may end but love and memorie

programme.title: Living In Two Worlds / 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. In spending peaceful time with his deaf mother after a long time, a memory that has been sealed away unexpectedly comes back to Dai.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: Dust to Dust / 爆谷獨家首播: 第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: In 1995, a large armed robbery occurred in Guangdong. A bank cash truck was robbed by five armed robbers, causing a loss of $15 million and three bank's escorts were killed. The incident shocked the whole country, the Police immediately set up a task force, led by Wang Shouyue and He Lan, and quickly found the whereabouts of the five robbers, except the real mastermind behind the case, the owner of a construction company, Chen Xinwen, and his cousin Chen Xinnian.Chen Xinwen and Chen Xinnian embarked on the road to escape, and has since evaporated. Twenty-one years later, the case has long faded from the public, and Wang Shouyue also retired. However, a usual video with a blurred figure rekindled his hope of solving the case...

programme.title: Bad Education (Director's Cut) / 黑的教育 (導演版)
programme.desc: On the night of their high school graduation, three juvenile delinquents find themselves getting drunk at their regular hangout, throwing beer bottles and enjoying the abuse hurled at them by nearby residents. But for these young men about to enter a new chapter of life, this little bit of chaos is nowhere near enough to farewell their dying youth. Before dawn, they decide to share their deepest, darkest secret with one another. After all, only true “bros” are qualified to know their most unspeakable deed...

programme.title: Concrete Utopia / 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: The Sleep Curse / 失眠
programme.desc: During Japan's wartime occupation of Hong Kong in 1941-1945, a young translator's collaboration with the enemy results in his life being cursed by a murdered 'comfort woman' forced to become a sex slave. Forty-five years later, the man's sins come back to haunt his son, a professor specializing in sleeping disorders, when the lady's ghost returns for vengeance.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E292 -In Broad Daylight / 爆谷電影現場 第292集 -白日之下
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Annapurna / 愛在安娜普納峰
programme.desc: On a sunny spring day, Kang Hyun goes hiking in Bugaksan Mountain with Sun Woo who has been recently discharged from the military. It is already past noon but they continue a casual conversation about their past relationships while hiking along trails. Kang Hyun reminisces about the bittersweet memories of his exes ‘Anna' and ‘Eun Chae', while Sun Woo regrets treating his ex ‘Eun Jung' badly and blames his immaturity in the past relationship with ‘Pureum'.Kang Hyun and Sun Woo come across different people along the trail. They pass by a good-looking woman in tight leggings who instantly capture their eyes. They also come across a middle-aged man who gives disappointing hiking tips, which make them feel hopeless. ‘Anna' and ‘Pureum' incarnate our bygone lovers who we once strongly admired but failed to reach.Though hiking is as tough as life can be, it can also bring you joy because some people come into our lives and make us happy. Though Annapurna is one of the toughest moun

programme.title: Needing You / 孤男寡女
programme.desc: Kinki is transferred to Andy's division due to 'office politics'. Rumors have it that Andy is womanizer and Kinki is unwilling to work with him! However, life is mysterious...

programme.title: Happy Go Lucky / 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Cantonese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does...

programme.title: Expect a Miracle / 蘋果咬一口
programme.desc: Miss Sung has come to Hong Kong to be a teacher, and hopefully moonlight as a model. On the Internet, she starts to talk with 'Blue Moon', a photographer. While attempting to shoot, the two have an argument, and Sung seems to lose her chance at being a model, until a second consideration by Jet leads to a completed shoot. Love between the two begins to bloom, but Jet's stepsister, who is also one of Miss Sung's students, starts to interfere, and may just ruin everything.

programme.title: Decision To Leave / 分手的決心
programme.desc: Kind and polite detective Haejun is entrusted with a case of unnatural death in the mountains. While investigating the case, he meets Seorae, the dead victim's wife, and can't help but both suspect and develop an interest in her.

programme.title: American Dreams in China / 中國合伙人
programme.desc: 80's. 3 undergraduates share a common ambition - to live the American dream. They establish a tutorial school New Vision, yet the sudden fame are tearing their friendship apart...

programme.title: Mighty Baby / 絕世好B
programme.desc: Lena, Johnny and Wayne are commissioned to expand a new line of business specializing in merchandise for infants named 'Mighty Baby'. Johnny, enjoying his new perks as a supervising executive, hires a neurotic secretary Sabrina. Knowing that her boyfriend Wayne is a 'baby-phobic', Lena seeks help from Boey, an expert in child behavioral patterns. Finally, Johnny and Wayne overcome a lot of obstacles to bring their 'What babies Want' product line to fruition......

programme.title: Labyrinth / 謎攻少女
programme.desc: Shiori, an ordinary high school student, dreams day and night of becoming viral on social media. One day, a crack appears on her smartphone screen and a virtual 'SHIORI' made of data is born. This new-born “SHIORI” not only upending her world but also replacing her real life. Trapped in the digital world, Shiori is powerless to save herself, watching helplessly as her imposter transforms into a vibrant idol and internet celebrity. In this digital Labyrinth, Shiori encounters a mysterious rabbit guy named 'Komori,' who guides her escape this bizarre and algorithm-constructed digital maze. Before herself is completely digitized and forgotten, she must find her way home...

programme.title: Following / 屍蹤
programme.desc: Entering the houses with the key entrusted to him by the clients, 'Koo Jung-tae', a real estate agent with a hobby of spying on other people's lives. He becomes intrigued by SNS influencer 'Han Sora'. She posts a photo of a vegan salad while actually eating convenience store sausage, prompting him to begin spying on her closely. ‘Koo Jung-tae', eventually sneaks into ‘Han Sora's house, discovers her lifeless body on the sofa. Soon after, he starts receiving threats from someone who knows he was there. As homicide detective 'Oh Young-joo's investigation closes in on him, ‘Koo Jung-tae' is compelled to search for the real culprit using clues from 'Han Sora's social media and the people around her.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E193 -A Light Never Goes Out / 爆谷電影現場 第193集 -燈火闌珊
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: A Light Never Goes Out / 匠心光影: 燈火闌珊
programme.desc: Widow Mei-heung has gone through countless sleepless nights since the death of her husband, Bill. One day, she finds a key among the items that Bill left behind, leading her to his secret neon workshop and his young apprentice, Leo. She learns from Leo that Bill had an unfulfilled last wish–to recreate a demolished legendary neon sign. With Leo's help, Mei-heung tries to uncover the story behind the sign and learns the craft of blowing neon lights in hopes of fulfilling her deceased husband's last wish with her own hands. Along the way, Mei-heung reminisces about her beautiful encounters with Bill and unearths pieces of Bill's past as if they are the last consolation left by him. Meanwhile, Mei-heung's daughter, Prism, plans to leave Hong Kong with her fiance, but she is unable to break the news to Mei-heung. As clues of the legendary neon sign gradually emerge, the secrets that Mei-heung couldn't face are about to be revealed...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Them, Behind the Door / 鬼們之蝴蝶大廈
programme.desc: A young mother and her child move into Room 606 of the infamous Butterfly Mansion, a notorious haunted building in the heart of Taipei. From the moment they arrive, eerie paranormal events begin to unfold, pushing her to uncover the dark secrets lurking within its walls. Amid the chaos, the building's new janitor-a kind and seemingly helpful young man-offers his support. But behind his warm smile lies a mystery of his own. As their paths intertwine, she realizes that everyone carries their own shadows, and the deeper she digs, the closer she gets to a chilling revelation. In Butterfly Mansion, the greatest lesson she learns is this: Humans Are More Terrifying Than Ghosts.

programme.title: Love Is Elsewhere / 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: The Shadowless Tower / 白塔之光
programme.desc: Gu Wentong, a middle-aged food critic, is drifting through the local eateries of vibrant Beijing with his younger photographer colleague Oyang. A divorce with a 6-year-old daughter and estranged from his father for decades, he is looking for a new perspective on life while reconsidering his failings as a father, a son, and a lover. While the seasons come and go, people get together and move apart. Only one thing will remain the same: The White Pagoda where they all meet sooner or later...

programme.title: As Long As We Both Shall Live / 我的幸福婚約
programme.desc: In a fictional Japan of Meiji Era, a time of remarkable civilization and enlightenment, people from families that have inherited special abilities [inou] have been protecting people from various disasters together with the emperor who rules the country. Miyo Saimori was from one of the prestigious families but born without the ability, and has lived her whole life being abused by her stepmother and half-sister. She is ordered to marry a ruthless soldier, Kiyoka Kudo, who leads the Alien Force at a young age, as a political ploy. True to the rumors that numerous potential fiancees had fled within three days, Kiyoka coldly told Miyo, 'You must obey me here. If I tell you to leave, leave. If I tell you to die, you die.” Miyo, who has no place to run away to, realizes during her stay at the Kudo household that Kiyoka is not the man he is reputed to be. Kiyoka is also touched by Miyo's thoughtfulness, and the two eventually establishes a special bond with each other. A light shine

programme.title: THE SHADOW'S EDGE / 捕風追影
programme.desc: A crew of criminal prodigies disappears with billions, evading capture by outsmarting the formidable “Sky Eye” surveillance system. Desperate and outmaneuvered, the Macau police enlist the help of a legend-Wong Tak-Chung, a retired tracking expert. He mentors rookie officer He Qiuguo and rebuilds an elite surveillance unit. Their mission: to track down the elusive “Wolf King,” Fu Longsheng, the mastermind behind the heist. As the police close in, the thieves spring a trap of their own. Brains clash, loyalties are tested, and the ultimate cat-and-mouse game is about to begin...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Frontline of Cold War / 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s......

programme.title: Are You Lonesome Tonight? / 熱帶往事
programme.desc: On a dark night, Xueming hits a pedestrian with his car and flees the scene. Desperate to escape his feelings of guilt, he decides to approach the dead man's wife, Mrs Liang. Meanwhile, the body is discovered - riddled with bullets. Chen, the detective in charge of the investigation, becomes obsessed with the case. Years later, all three remain caught in a tangled web of memories and lies, desperately searching for a truth that refuses to be revealed...

programme.title: Reign of Assassins / 劍雨
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: All The Long Nights / 長夜盡頭的微光
programme.desc: After a series of mishaps at work caused by her severe pre-menstrual syndrome, Fujisawa lands a new job at an astronomical toy factory, where she meets Yamazoe, a tacit colleague plagued by panic attacks. There the two, whose careers have been derailed by their respective conditions, learn to support and care for each other through life's ups and downs despite their initial friction.

programme.title: Wine War / 搶紅
programme.desc: Shui Zhang and Waley were buddies at an orphanage. Adopted by a French couple and moved to France at a young age, Waley has become a wine connoisseur prodigy. Left alone, Shui Zhang grows up to be a braggart and a nobody. When Shui Zhang travels to France one day to enlist Waley's help in auctioning a bottle of red wine called 'The God of Wine,' said to contain Kublai Khan's secret wine-brewing recipe, Waley accepted the challenge in a heartbeat. During the auction, Waley encounters a representative from the seller, the beautiful Yvonne, and falls in love with her at first sight. The other potential buyer is the wealthy and imposing coal tycoon Changfang Fang. While he appears to be a rich and vulgar brute on the surface, he is much more than meets the eyes. Adding to the mystery is the private connoisseur of suspicious origins following Fang everywhere. To Waley's surprise, Zhang and Fang seem to be sharing secrets between themselves. The group of buyers set off an out-of-ha

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E278 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第278集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 77 Heartbreaks / 原諒他77次
programme.desc: When Adam and Eva break up after ten years, Adam thinks the breach was caused by one trivial incident, but Eva knows she's already forgiven Adam 77 times! Sweethearts since law school, Adam changed professions to start a Thai boxing studio and gradually became indifferent to Eva. Seemingly petty matters, like forgetting she hates raisin cookies, become the catalyst for her moving out and changing her Facebook status to 'single'. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' Reading it makes Adam realize his love. But what can he do to win her back? And what secret is contained in the journal's torn-out last page? He rushes to Eva and melts her heart by recounting their happy memories. When Eva tells him Heartbreak #77

programme.title: Fantasia / 鬼馬狂想曲
programme.desc: In Hong Kong 1969, private investigation agency boss Man is investigating an extra marital case. With his two employees, the smart looking idiot Kit and the Hong Kong Columbia Radio Night School graduate Pufferfish, he follows the target Lascar Row. The trio stumbles into an antique shop and breaks many antiques in the store. The cheap Man force Kit and Pufferfish to take responsibility. Kit wisely makes Pufferfish take sole responsibility. The dumb Pufferfish helpless buys the pile of shattered antiques with his own money. In the pieces he finds a broken magic lamp...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E187 -Day Off / 爆谷電影現場 第187集 -本日公休
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: DAY OFF / 匠心光影: 本日公休
programme.desc: For forty years A-Rui has been running a barbershop, a small place where she has seen happiness and sorrow, ebb and flow. Faced with all the troubles in her life, A-Rui fully commits to her work and defeat is never an option for her, but her children never appreciate it and treat her profession with disdain. One day, A-Rui receives a phone call from the family of an old regular client who moved far away a long time ago. The family asks A-Rui if she would be willing to travel to cut the hair for the bedridden old man. Reminded of what her master taught her, “Always provide your best service,” A-Rui decides to hang up the “Day Off” sign and closes her shop for one day. She drives her beat-up old car and embarks on a long journey to do something others think is not worthwhile.

programme.title: The Rising Star -Renci Yeung / 我要做接班人 -楊偲泳
programme.desc: How did a late-night street shoot ignite Renci Yeung's dream of becoming an actress? Describing herself as a blend of conflicting rational and emotional sides, she found an outlet for her emotions through acting. How does she calmly face scrutiny and criticism from the public when taking on daring roles? Ten years into her career, this rising talent keeps cherishing every hard-won opportunity and moving forward with a free-spirited attitude and the same initial thrill for acting that first ignited her passion.

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie / 調教我的喪屍女兒
programme.desc: Jung-hwan, a professional wild animal trainer, spends his days bickering and playing with his teenage daughter, Soo-ah, who is passionate about dancing. Then one day, Soo-ah gets infected by a zombie virus that sweeps across the world. To protect her, Jung-hwan takes Soo-ah to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Bam-soon, lives. In a society determined to root out the infected, Jung-hwan notices that Soo-ah still seems to understand words, responds to her favorite songs and dances, and even flinches when scolded by Grandma Bam-soon's back scratching stick. Refusing to give up on his daughter, Jung-hwan calls on his years of animal training experience and begins the top-secret mission of training his zombie daughter...

programme.title: Enter The Phoenix / 大佬愛美麗
programme.desc: Georgie's dad, Hung, was a Triad leader. After Hung's death, his right-hand Cheung intends to bring back Georgie to take over. But Cheung finds Sam, whom he mistakes for Georgie...

programme.title: Mirai / 未來的未來
programme.desc: The movie follows a 4-year old boy who is struggling to cope with the arrival of a little sister in the family, until things turn magical. A mysterious garden in the backyard of the boy's home becomes a gateway allowing the child to travel back in time and encounter his mother as a little girl and his great-grandfather as a young man. These fantasy-filled adventures allow the child to change his perspective and help him become the big brother he was meant to be.

programme.title: After School / 成功補習班
programme.desc: The year is 1994. As the life-changing college examination looms on the horizon for Heng and his two best friends, they spend their days pulling pranks at their cram school, obsessing over sex and stressing over their uncertain futures. However, the cram school's new tutor, Teacher Chih, manages to tame the wild trio and helps them discover their true selves.

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K...

programme.title: Manhunt / 追捕
programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder?

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E220 -WE 12 / 爆谷電影現場 第220集 -12怪盜
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: WE 12 / 12怪盜
programme.desc: In the world, which is ordinary yet a little bit extraordinary, there is an underground organization called the 'The League of Kaito'. Their members silently guard the social order and peace. Within the organization, there are 12 geniuses, each with their own unique skills. Kaito Ian is good at planning, Kaito KT is a master of hypnosis, Kaito Stanley is skilled in eavesdropping, Kaito A.Lo is most adaptable, Kaito Edan is excellent in abseiling, Kaito Jer can instantly disguise himself, Kaito Tiger knows how to read lips from a distance, Kaito Alton is a world-class hacker, Kaito AK masters animal telepathy, Kaito Lokman is familiar with unlocking techniques, Kaito Frankie has the strongest sixth sense, and Kaito Jeremy has a natural super memory and can read and memorize large amounts of information at a glance. They are the star members of the League of Kaito. One day, they received instructions from Boss, to gather at headquarters to complete an important case that will a

programme.title: A Taxi Driver / 逆權司機
programme.desc: May 1980. A Seoul taxi driver named Man-seob comes across an offer too good to be true. If he drives a foreign passenger from Seoul down to Gwangju and back again before the curfew, he'll be paid the unthinkable sum of 100,000 won – enough to cover several months of unpaid rent. Without stopping to ask the details, he picks up the German reporter Peter and sets off along the highway. Although stopped by police roadblocks at the edge of Gwangju, Man-seob is desperate to earn his taxi fare, and eventually manages to find a way into the city. There they encounter students and ordinary citizens taking part in large-scale demonstrations against the government. Man-seob, alarmed by the danger in the air, pleads with Peter to go quickly back to Seoul. But Peter ignores him...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E284 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第284集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Chang An / 長安三萬里
programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.

programme.title: Himalaya Singh / 喜馬拉亞星
programme.desc: Singh is borne and grown up in Himalayas and has reached the ultimate stage in Yoga. He goes to participate the India Beauty's husband-to-be contest. He meets the wanna-be-married Tally. Tally proposed to induce Singh to be a rotten, so India Beauty has a bad husband. Uncle Panic goes traveling to India with his two nephews. Uncle Brave who is one of the tourists has absolutely opposite character. Uncle Panic bumps into several India robbers who hypnotize him and was brought into the Journey Of Illusion by The Peacock...

programme.title: Hit N Fun / 臨時決鬥
programme.desc: “CHUNG LUI SOCIETY” is a boxing gym founded by the former legendary Muay Thai champion CHUNG Lui, who is dedicated to training professional fighters. Despite the gym's struggles, he remains committed to his lifelong philosophy of never backing down from a challenge. Businesswoman Elsa discovers that her boyfriend Daniel is cheating on her with Macau's female champion, Surewin. Driven by her competitive spirit, Elsa vows to settle their score in the ring. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. There, she encounters MOK Ka Lei, who had previously clashed with her during an advertisement shoot. After leaving the entertainment industry to support her family, Ka Lei attempts to make a comeback, with the help of her friend LAM Pik Chu. Under the rigorous training of Lui's protege, KO Chau, Elsa undergoes intense preparation. Alth

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E298 -The Remnant / 爆谷電影現場 第298集 -惡人當道
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: Hokusai / 匠心光影: 北齋：浮世繪傳奇
programme.desc: In the Edo-era, young impecunious artist Katsushika Hokusai lived in downtown Edo. He was shabby and lived from hand to mouth with little money he earned by selling his painting on the streets. But Tsutaya Juzaburo, the one of a kind publisher, discovered Hokusai's hidden talent and led him to unleash his potentials. With Juzaburo's help, Hokusai found the essence of drawing and his talent bloomed. Meanwhile, the entertainment ban came in effect by the Edo shogunate. While Hokusai became older, he built a strong relationship with Ryutei Tanehiko, the popular playwright, who was born as a samurai and was distressed in creating new plays because of the prohibition. Eventually Tanehiko got executed by the shogunate. Hokusai came out with all his repulsion against the Edo shogunate on his vivid drawings.

programme.title: Husband Killers / 女士復仇
programme.desc: If hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, imagine the nightmare that's about to be visited upon the man who has scorned three women. Professional killer Chanel has been happily married for ten years, but she discovers that her husband has been carrying on an affair with Dior, a thief. Before the women can tear each other apart, they learn that he also has a third woman, Hermes. When the avenging duo arrives at a hotel to stop their next rendezvous, they find out that Hermes is ready for war.

programme.title: 2gether: The Movie / 只因我們天生一對：電影版
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.

programme.title: Suzume / 鈴芽之旅
programme.desc: Suzume, a 17-year-old girl who lives in a quiet town in Kyushu, meets Souta, a young man looking for a door. Following Souta, Suzume finds an old door in the mountains and reaches out her hands towards the door as if pulled by something. This opened door will bring disaster; thus, Souta must travel around to lock the door to avoid disaster. But then, a mysterious kitten turns Souta into a broken wooden chair. To catch the kitten, Suzume and Souta follow it and travel from Kyushu to Tokyo. “Doors of disaster” begin to appear across Japan simultaneously, and Suzume needs to close and lock the doors one by one to stop the disasters. Unexpectedly, a forgotten truth is waiting for her.

programme.title: Unbeatable / 激戰
programme.desc: After a stint in prison for participating in underground boxing, Fai is knee-deep in debt with no solution in sight. To escape his debtors, he flees to Macau and works as a gym assistant. He meets and ends up training Si-Qi, a hot-blooded young man who enrolled in an open MMA competition with no fighting experience. After a series of wins, Si-Qi is critically injured and eliminated from the tournament. Ignited by Si-Qi's persistence and unwillingness to give up in the face of defeat, he rediscovers his will to fight and steps back in the ring against the fighter who injured his student...

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot / 曾經擁有
programme.desc: Anyone who has anything to do with the film industry in Hong Kong, must have heard of a film buff called Lil' Kim. He knows everything there is to know about filmmaking. Whether it's on the set, at the movie premiere or at a press conference, he always shows up uninvited. Nobody knows where he came from and why he showed up... Ginger Keung is the producer of a reality show who suspects Lil' Kim is in fact a film critic who pans movies to extort advertising dollars from film companies. She zeroes in on Lil' Kim as her next target and decides to dig into his elusive past...

programme.title: Special Delivery / 極速快遞
programme.desc: “I deliver everything that the post office service does not handle.” Eun-ha, who is a normal junkyard employee, secretly works as a delivery clerk that deals with unusual delivery request. One day, Eun-ha heads to Seoul to pick up a client who is involved in a gambling crime that wants to flee overseas. However, Eun-ha meets the client's young son at the pick-up point, instead of the client himself. Kyung-pil, a current police officer who is actually masterminding the whole gambling crime, chases after the missing child who has the security key to the bank account that holds 30 million dollars. After a long pursuit from Seoul to Busan, Eun-ha fights against the police to protect the child!

programme.title: Perfect Wedding / 抱抱俏佳人
programme.desc: One night, wedding planner - Yan met a young attorney, Fun and had a one-night stand. Later, Fung did accidentally join to Yan's wedding planning company. In a special wedding, regardless of Yan against Fung, the rigid procedures of the wedding ceremony turned into a warm, touching the carnival. Customers in more than touched, the two are deeply moved a step closer so emotional. However, the emotional harm suffered psychological Yan still cannot break the shackles of courage in the face of her girlfriends Fung's hand holding a bold recognition of this relationship. At this time, her fiance - Kelvin was again disrupted Yan's emotional world. Who is her true Love....?

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: LAST MILE / LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web?

programme.title: Emergency Declaration / 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Deconstructing the Cold War Universe / 爆谷製造 -拆解寒戰宇宙
programme.desc: Director Longman Leung is here to shed light on the mysteries of the “Cold War” series. What actually does the operation codename “Cold War” mean? Longman reveals that not a single shot had been fired in the first script while the foreshadowing in dialogue of 'Cold War' and 'Cold War 2' are going to be revealed in the sequel! Let's find out more behind-the-scenes stories of the “Cold War” series shared by Longman.

programme.title: Pierce / 刺心切骨
programme.desc: Young fencer Zijie finds his world upended when his older brother, three-time national fencing champion Zihan, is released from juvenile prison. Zihan was incarcerated for what he maintains was the accidental death of an opponent. Zijie wants some connection (and fencing tips) from his enigmatic older brother, but their mother is convinced of Zihan's malevolence and seeks to end their brotherly bond. Featuring meticulously staged fencing matches and pitch-perfect performances, this unnerving psychodrama announces Nelicia Low as a future talent to follow.

programme.title: Night King (Director's Cut) / 夜王 (導演版)
programme.desc: The long-awaited director's cut, with around half hour of unrevealed and breathtaking highlights! The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Foon and Madame V join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom!

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: Cobweb / 匠心光影: 韓戲逼人
programme.desc: After his successful debut, Director KIM endures scathing attacks from critics who call him a specialist in trashy dramas. After finishing his latest feature ‘Cobweb', he has vivid dreams over several days of an alternative ending to the film. Sensing that if he can just shoot those scenes as he envisioned them, a masterpiece will surely emerge, he tries to arrange just two days of additional shooting. However, the rewritten script fails to pass censorship, and his actors can't make sense of the new ending. Between the tangled schedule, the opposition of the producer, and the collision between these fantastic scenes dancing before his eyes and the harsh conditions of reality, Director KIM feels he is about to go insane, but he pushes on regardless...

programme.title: Confession Of Pain / 傷城
programme.desc: In a city of love and prosperity, a city of lost hope and premature death, veteran detective Hei feels it all: the hurt, the helplessness, the horror. When his father-in-law, the billionaire benefactor Chau, is gruesomely murdered in his palatial mansion, he enlists the assistance of his former partner turned private detective, Bong.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette / 手捲煙
programme.desc: Former Hong Kong Military Service Corps officer becomes caught in a triad manhunt when he takes in an ethnic South Asian man carrying a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live under the same roof, the two men transcend their cultural and racial differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Twilight Online / 恐怖在線
programme.desc: In 2003, a collision between a double-decker bus and a truck in Tuen Mun took the lives of 21 people. Ten years after the accident, several tenants on the Yau Oi Estate, which is located near the scene of the collision, report witnessing a woman clad in red jumping to her death on multiple nights, prompting veteran police officer Gu to go investigate with rookie cop Bee At the same time, radio DJ Poon Siu Chung returns to the site of the Tuen Mun collision with a group of students hoping to investigate the circumstances of the crash. When strange things start happening to the students, Gu and Bee are called to help. The two seemingly unconnected investigations converge as Gu realizes the incidents are connected.

programme.title: Ichikei’s Crow The Movie / 第一刑事部的烏鴉
programme.desc: Two years have passed since Michio Irima left first criminal court (commonly known as “Ichikei”). Michio is transferred to Setouchi in Okayama Prefecture, where he is assigned to an assault case involving the youngest Minister of Defense in history. His investigations lead him to look into a collision incident involving an Aegis warship, but the details of the ships voyage are a national secret. Michio is now faced with an adversary upon which the threat of “official authority” does not work. Meanwhile, Chizuru Sakama, who has tried numerous cases with Michio, is working as a lawyer in a neighboring town under a work experience program. There, she takes on a case involving a large local company which supports the whole town, but not all is as it seems...Between these seemingly disparate cases, a shocking truth arises. Are they opening a Pandora's Box that was best left alone?!

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E142 -Bodyguards and Assassins / 爆谷電影現場 第142集 -十月圍城
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins / 十月圍城
programme.desc: 1906, City of Victoria (British Colony of Hong Kong). In the distance of thirteen blocks, the one man who holds a nation's fate must survive relentless attempts on his life with only eight bodyguards to protect him. Against hundreds of assassins, these men must put their courage to the test in order to protect the hopes of millions in this perilous night even if it means fighting to the death...

programme.title: Distinction / 非同凡響
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.

programme.title: Ghost Cat Anzu / 佛系貓物語
programme.desc: Karin, 11 years old, finds herself abandoned by her father in a small Japanese town, where her grandfather, a monk, resides. Her grandfather asks Anzu, his jovial and helpful, although rather capricious, ghost cat, to look after her. As their spirited personalities collide, sparks fly-yet perhaps only in the beginning.

programme.title: I Sell Love / 販賣．愛
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before...

programme.title: Ransomed / 救參的士
programme.desc: In 1987, diplomat 'Min-jun' was unable to escape the Middle East Department at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for five years. One day, he receives a coded message from a missing diplomat in Lebanon, who was kidnapped 20 months ago. Filled with hopeful aspirations of a promotion to the United States if successful, he volunteers for an unofficial mission to rescue his colleague and heads to Lebanon. Upon arrival at the airport, 'Min-jun' narrowly avoids a hail of bullets from airport security guards who are after his life. By chance, he ends up getting into the car of a Korean taxi driver named 'Pan-su'. With local gangsters hot on their heels attempting to steal the ransom money, 'Min-jun' has no choice but to rely on expat Pan-su, the only fellow Korean around. However, can this shady character, who will do anything for money, truly help in rescuing his colleague?

programme.title: Temporary Family / 失戀急讓
programme.desc: Lung is facing a serious situation in life. His girlfriend won't marry him unless he can buy her a 1000-sq ft apartment in one year's time...

programme.title: Another World / 世外
programme.desc: Tasked to help transient souls through Another World to their reincarnation, the spirit GUDO meets a young girl called YURI, and embarks on a dangerous journey to help her overcome her anger and prevent her curse from destroying the world.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: Stuntman / 匠心光影: 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w

programme.title: Twins Effect, The / 千機變
programme.desc: Ace Vampire slayer Reeve and his new partner Gipsy are on this mission, however Reeve's younger sister Helen falls in love with the Vampire fifth prince Kazaf.

programme.title: The Bodyguard / 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: Rule #1 / 第一誡
programme.desc: Every day, the Police Force receives 185 phone calls.180 of them are about burglaries, murders, rapes and kidnappings. The remaining 5 begin with: “There is something strange in my house, can you please send someone over to take a look?” For rookie Sergeant Lee, being a cop means running down crooks and upholding the law. Injured in a shoot-out, he finds out to his horror that he is reassigned to the dubious-sounding Miscellaneous Affairs Department (MAD)...

programme.title: Look For A Star / 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight...

programme.title: Killing Romance / 浪漫特攻隊
programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Napping Kid / 逆向誘拐
programme.desc: Siu-yu, a financial analyst who has been working to complete a budget analyst for an investment bank, finds that a file containing confidential information has been mysteriously deleted. Soon after, her boss, John, receives a ransom email from someone called K Kidnapper, demanding just $190,000 worth of ransom. The ransom must be paid in 3 days, otherwise they will share the information to public. Under a detective's secret investigation, everyone could be the suspect...

programme.title: Better Days / 少年的你
programme.desc: On the cusp of the competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.

programme.title: The Rising Star -Renci Yeung / 我要做接班人 -楊偲泳
programme.desc: How did a late-night street shoot ignite Renci Yeung's dream of becoming an actress? Describing herself as a blend of conflicting rational and emotional sides, she found an outlet for her emotions through acting. How does she calmly face scrutiny and criticism from the public when taking on daring roles? Ten years into her career, this rising talent keeps cherishing every hard-won opportunity and moving forward with a free-spirited attitude and the same initial thrill for acting that first ignited her passion.

programme.title: Life is Beautiful / 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: The Monkey King / 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time, there existed in the world three clans; human, god and demon. As everything was destroyed during the great battle, Nuwa (Goddess of Works) used 36,500 magic boulders to repair Heaven. One of them fell accidentally down onto Earth and landed on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits on an island far across the Eastern Sea. Over thousands of years, the magic boulder absorbed the energies of Heaven and Earth and the sacred lights of the Sun and Moon. A godly creature was nurtured inside the stone-egg and a full-grown monkey burst out from it one day. When the Patriarch Subodhi passed by on his way to collect herbs in the Mountain, he came upon the monkey. Impressed by his exceptional wit and godly he took the monkey back to the Divine Cave of Three Stars in Mountain Mi to teach him the Way and called him Sun Wukong...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E288 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第288集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Grand Maison Paris / 摘星廚神．巴黎夢
programme.desc: After their restaurant 'Grand Maison Tokyo' earned a Michelin three-star, Natsuki Obana and Rinko Hayami venture to Paris to open 'Grand Maison Paris,' aiming to become the first Asian chefs to achieve the same honor. However, they face cultural challenges and intense pressure in a city filled with culinary masters. Following a mishap at a gala dinner, Obana makes a pact with his former mentor: he will leave France if they don't earn three stars in the next Michelin evaluation. Can Obana and his team overcome these obstacles to achieve their dream?

programme.title: Integrity / 廉政風雲 煙幕
programme.desc: The multi-year ICAC investigation into the Lida Conglomerate is on the brink of collapse after the CEO's disappearance and the whistleblower's fleeing to Australia. To salvage the case, a top ICAC agent teams with a fellow investigator (who happens to be his estranged wife) and risks their lives to bring the witness back to Hong Kong.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: Fagara / 匠心光影: 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taipei and one in Chongqing. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taipei sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from Chongqing is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: Her Vengeance / 血玫瑰
programme.desc: Chieh-ying, the head of a Macau dancing group, has a peaceful and calm life. One day, five drunken men, who were the murderers of Chieh-ying's dad, came to watch the show and had a brawl with Chieh-ying. On her way home, Chieh-ying got caught. She was raped and tortured by them. After that, Chieh-ying felt herself sick and was contracted the venereal disease. Therefore, she decided to go to Hong Kong to seek vengeance. She met a journalist and stayed at his home. To earn a living, Chieh-ying worked as a barmaid at a bar of Chow, her sister's ex-boyfriend with the help from Susan. One evening, Chieh-ying saw one of those five men when she was on the way to work. Susan lured him away so Chieh-ying could kill him. Chieh-ying then started a trail of bloody revenge...

programme.title: Tricky Brains / 整蠱專家

programme.title: Centre Stage / 阮玲玉

When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him?

programme.title: A Taste of Killing and Romance / 殺手的童話

Sammy retires to Crow's home town and falls in love with his sister. Kui begins to turn against Crow. He sends Crow to Hong Kong and orders to kill him. At the same moment, Kui's men come for him and kill his sister who comes with Sammy to deliver their wedding news. With Sammy by his side, Crow starts his vendetta...

Hired to track down the runaway daughter of a publishing tycoon, Ryo ends up on a luxury cruise ship hijacked by terrorists. With the help from his jealous assistant Carrie, undercover agent Saeko and gambler Gundam, Ryo must foil the nefarious plot.

programme.title: The Lion Roars / 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses...

programme.title: No More Love No More Death / 太子傳說
programme.desc: Cheung is Prince, the son of crime boss Mr. Pak in the underworld. He kills flamboyantly with the help of partner Ching Ching, who was a gift from Mr. Pak many years ago. Still, despite Ching's constant companionship, Prince longs for a woman he has seen in his dreams since youth. The dream girl is a dancer Tweedy. He also longs to kill Drago, who was supposedly responsible for taking his mother away. Dragon actually has his own vendetta against Pak, as Pak kidnapped his son many years ago. The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

programme.title: Fennie Yuen’s Movie Life: School On Fire / 「瑩」畫人生: 學校風雲
programme.desc: Chu Yuen Fong, a typical Hong Kong high school girl, witnesses a traffic accident. Encouraged by her teacher, Mr. Wan, Chu decides to testify in court. As her testimony is unfavorable to members of the underworld, she is threatened for exchange of money. Unexpectedly, her good friend, Siu Chun comes to her rescue by providing her with the money. They become even closer friends. Under the persuasion of her boyfriend, who has underworld connection, Sui Chun turns to prostitution. She thus knows how malicious the dangerous web could be. Meanwhile, Mr. Wan finds that both the two girls are falling and observes that they are under bad influence. He tries to put them back on the right track. However, he's threatened by the underworld people and loses his job. At the same time, Siu Chun suicides after she realizes that she is being used by his boyfriend. Realizing these two facts, Chu determines to make good use of the law.

programme.title: Gen-X Cops / 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'...

However, a warm and close friendship has been established among the four. In order to recover the heartbreak of Fred, Ken suggested a tour to Penang to cheer up Fred. They came across two beautiful girls, Maggie and Agnes, strolling leisurely on the beach as if they were very wealthy. Since then they decided on courtship. They played a poker game to decide who's to who. And Fred, the winner, chose Maggie to be his sole target. By the rules of the game, Ken, Silver and Tong have to compete to see who in the ends will win the heart of Agnes...

programme.desc: Long ago, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time...

Michael also has eyes for Brandon's girl, May. While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire...

programme.desc: Dragon and Pool are friends in the triad. Dragon saves Gigi and touches her at a life and death moment. But they have an inexplicable history which is a thwart to their love...

programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs...

He was punished to find a virgin boy who was born in the year of 'Sun Mou', the 15th of August of midnight for the consecration of new idol. In order to find that virgin boy, he was unfortunately involved in a murdering case. Many years ago, in the Science Clan, there was a Starry Devil who was cruel and brutal and often committed the rules of the Clan. On one occasion, while he was trying to steal the Leader's Writ, he was being discovered and punished by peeling off his hand's skin then expelled out of the Clan. Wu's grandmother was one of the executors and also the protector of the writ...

programme.desc: As a low-ranking director in Channel 9, Liu Pat turns the station's programmes tremendously vivid. So the boss of Channel 8 orders to get back the audience by hooks or by crooks...

programme.desc: A new school term begins. Vivacious high school girl Jane hurries back to Hong Kong from overseas, where she spent her vacation. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

programme.desc: So, the legendary beggar, is actually born in a princely rich family. Like his father, So leads a lavish life. He once meets Ju Suan and falls in love with the virgin prostitute..
