programme.desc: The film was set in the 1970s, Dai Cheng-wah was a top law student in the University of Hong Kong. He fell in love with an orphan Suk-fun. His father opposed this relationship. The lovers eventually got married and Suk-fun dropped out of school because of pregnancy. Cheng-wah continued his studies and graduated. Under his father's influence, he was only able to work in a shabby law firm. After Suk-fun gave birth to triplets, Cheng-wah had a heavy burden. Finally, Cheng-wah won lawsuit and gained fame. However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness...

David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time...

programme.title: Lost And Found / 天涯海角
programme.desc: Kelly, suffers from leukemia, encounters a sailor named Michael who comes from the North Sea of Scotland. Love comes and goes until Takeshi comes to her life...

programme.desc: The story is set against the backdrop of Hong Kong in 1941. Fai, a young man who's trying to scrape up enough money to catch a boat to the U.S. He befriends Kong, who comes from a wealthy family but now works as a coolie working for a successful rice merchant. Kong's childhood friend, Anna who is betrothed to a man by her politically ambitions father. The trio decides to make a run for the boat but on the day of their planned escape, the war breaks out and they are forced to stay behind. Fai signs up to work for the enemy to help Kong and Anna in their next attempt to escape...

programme.title: The Beloved Son Of God / 肥貓流浪記
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a good-natured but mentally retarded adult, is jailed for two years before being bailed out by the Social Welfare Department for good behaviour. Discharges and an orphan, Fat Cat is placed in the custody of a Social Welfare worker Bibi, but there is a communication gap between the two. One day, Bibi takes him to Lantau Island to visit his late parents' grave. As he is crying his heart out, Bibi is involved in a traffic accident, leaving him alone on the Island to lead a wandering life. Seized by cold and hunger at night, Fat Cat tries to steal food from a puppy and is spotted by a stubborn but kind-hearted elder, Granduncle. Failing to find where Fat Cat lives, he takes him home and adopts him. The presence of the simple-minded but optimistic Fat Cat brings much hilarity to the otherwise moribund village. He also wins the elder's favour for resolving the difference between him and his neighbouring youth James, and the three become good friends...

programme.title: Fennie Yuen’s Movie Life: Swordsman / 「瑩」畫人生: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity...

programme.title: Heart Into Hearts / 三人新世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, has been living with Chu Lai Ngo and her daughter Vivian, in harmony. Alex has to go to Paris with director Joe, for ad production. Due to the suspicion of Alex's fidelity, Chu and Vivian follow Alex to Paris and cause dramatic argument with Joe. Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada...

programme.desc: Personal and interest conflicts between two garage owners Ken and Jim along with Ken's four young men staffs and Jim's four young girl helpers make them compete with each other...

programme.desc: Kudzu, Mud Carp and Bean depend on each other for survival since their parents died. Kudzu, the eldest of three sisters, gave up her studies and runs a fish stall in Luen Yee Hui market to raise her two young sisters. She is a super fan of the famous Singer, Alex. Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed...

In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Ostensibly, he publishes a newspaper. But his real business is still the forgoing of banknotes. Cindy gets a job as the paper's reporter but alert Hong Kong police tell her to keep off. It is their job to get Huang. Cindy happens to know her friend's father is the prosecutor in Huang's trial. She tries to help but Huang gets off by poisoning the prosecutor. Now Cindy is desperate. The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself...

Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up!

programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along...

programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl...

programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide?

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk S1E4 -India & Sri Lanka's Deadly Mother's Day / 朝暮動物誌 第4集 - 印度和斯里蘭卡的致命母親節
programme.desc: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E1 -The Fickle River / 逐雨之途 第1集 - 善變之河
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E2 -Blood and Dust / 逐雨之途 第2集 - 血與塵
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E3 -Praying for Rain / 逐雨之途 第3集 - 祈雨
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E3 -The Missing Manzi / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第3集 - 消失的曼齊成員
programme.desc: Join Julz and park scout Simon Chulu as they track the Kakuli pack, who they filmed last year, and a Manzi faction who’ve ditched a tracking collar and broken away from the group. Spot the Kakumbi making a kill before a happy Manzi reunion ensues.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E4 -The Protectors / 狗建奇工 第4集 - 保衛者
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E5 -The Scent Detectives / 狗建奇工 第5集 - 氣味偵探
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africa’s most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial male’s bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E6 -Caiman / 野性科學 第6集 - 美洲鱷
programme.desc: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

programme.desc: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkey’s nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E1 -Earth / 地球演化實錄 第1集 - 地土探秘
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E2 -Islands / 地球演化實錄 第2集 - 多樣島嶼
programme.desc: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E3 -Heat / 地球演化實錄 第3集 - 灼熱地球
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E4 -Ice / 地球演化實錄 第4集 - 冰海之間
programme.desc: Trek to the planet’s quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E5 -Grasslands / 地球演化實錄 第5集 - 草原奧祕
programme.desc: Explore one of Earth’s most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E4 -Family Dynamics / 獅群的法則 第4集 - 家族脈動
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E5 -Einstein Rules / 獅群的法則 第5集 - 愛因斯坦主宰
programme.desc: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn / 驕傲之地：野地回春
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions / 大貓九命 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E1 -Einstein Must Go! / 獅群的法則 第1集 - 愛因斯坦必須離開！
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein’s defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E2 -Adapt Or Die / 獅群的法則 第2集 - 適者生存
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E3 -Hide and Seek / 獅群的法則 第3集 - 捉迷藏戲
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E5 -Tragedy Strikes Kakumbi / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第5集 - 卡昆比遭受打擊
programme.desc: Feel your heart race when the Kakumbi tree a leopard who’s been stalking them. Join Julz on a ZCP lion-collaring mission, go fishing with scout Simon, explore mealtime pack hierarchy, and witness a heartbreaking vigil for a badly injured Kakumbi pup.

programme.title: Life's Journey S1E1 -Life Begins / 生命之旅 第1集 - 生命的起點
programme.desc: For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulnerable to attack.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E1 -Lyca the Painted Wolf / 野小子 第1集 - 非洲野犬賴卡
programme.desc: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E2 -Chinga the Lion Cub / 野小子 第2集 - 幼獅青加
programme.desc: In South Africa’s Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E3 -Usana the Cheetah Cub / 野小子 第3集 - 小獵豹烏珊娜
programme.desc: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she’s got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E4 -Chico the Baby Capuchin / 野小子 第4集 - 卷尾猴嬰兒施高
programme.desc: In Brazil’s Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E5 -Ravi the Baby Lion Tailed Macaque / 野小子 第5集 - 年幼獅尾猴華菲
programme.desc: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist / 潛鳥：迷霧中的吶喊
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summer’s soundtrack or go silent forever.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E1 -Chasing Freedom / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第1集 - 追逐自由
programme.desc: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poacher’s snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E2 -Monkey Madness / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第2集 - 失控的猴子
programme.desc: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E3 -The Great Escape / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第3集 - 大逃亡
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E4 -Big Buck Chase / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第4集 - 拯救水羚
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poacher's snare. Meanwhile, the center's resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E5 -Creatures Great and Small / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第5集 - 不分大小
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E1 -The Hungry Leopard / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 餓豹傳說
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E2 -A Leopard's Last Stand / 非洲獵人 第2集 - 背水一戰
programme.desc: A wise, old leopard reigns over the Luangwa Valley in Zambia. She holds her own against lions, but is about to face her most serious challenge - the arrival of a younger, nomadic female leopard. Witness the bitter battle of experience versus vitality.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E4 -The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots / 非洲獵人 第4集 - 斑點幻變的豹
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill S1E1 -The Ghost of the Mountains / 雪豹獵奇 第1集 - 高山之靈
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill S1E2 -To Catch a Legend / 雪豹獵奇 第2集 - 追捕傳奇
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dude’s territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard / 野獸絕地求生記 第6集 - 與豹同行
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S1E1 -Africa's Big Cats / 野生動物明星 第1集 - 非洲大貓
programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E1 -The Hungry Leopard / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 餓豹傳說

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E6 -Manzi the Superpack / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第6集 - 超級族群曼齊
programme.desc: Head back to the den with the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups. Chance upon a hyena den and a lion pride trying to take down a buffalo, then catch up with the Manzi, who are in a standoff with a leopard and a herd of angry elephants.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms S1E1 -Water Worlds / 歐洲野性王國 第1集 - 水之世界
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms S1E2 -Mountain Worlds / 歐洲野性王國 第2集 - 山之世界
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe’s most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that’s cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn / 驕傲之地：野地回春
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E1 -Raw Power / 超獸 第1集 - 原始力量
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom’s most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E2 -Super Speed / 超獸 第2集 - 超級速度
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth’s fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E1 -Ultimate Predator / 鯊魚星球 第1集 - 終極獵手
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey’s heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E6 -Catch Me if You Can / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第6集 - 來追我
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the team's plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.desc: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

programme.desc: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies’ flirty flashes, the tarsier’s incredible night vision, the mantis shrimp’s knockout punch, and the saltwater croc’s prey-detecting pressure sensors.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard / 野獸絕地求生記 第6集 - 與豹同行

programme.desc: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowner's pets.

programme.title: Into the Wild India S1E5 -Rana: Queen of the Jungle / 深入印度 第5集 - 叢林虎媽
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk S1E4 -India & Sri Lanka's Deadly Mother's Day / 朝暮動物誌 第4集 - 印度和斯里蘭卡的致命母親節
programme.desc: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S1E1 -Africa's Big Cats / 野生動物明星 第1集 - 非洲大貓
programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E1 -The Fickle River / 逐雨之途 第1集 - 善變之河
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E2 -Blood and Dust / 逐雨之途 第2集 - 血與塵
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E3 -Praying for Rain / 逐雨之途 第3集 - 祈雨
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E3 -The Missing Manzi / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第3集 - 消失的曼齊成員
programme.desc: Join Julz and park scout Simon Chulu as they track the Kakuli pack, who they filmed last year, and a Manzi faction who’ve ditched a tracking collar and broken away from the group. Spot the Kakumbi making a kill before a happy Manzi reunion ensues.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E4 -The Protectors / 狗建奇工 第4集 - 保衛者
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E5 -The Scent Detectives / 狗建奇工 第5集 - 氣味偵探
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard / 野獸絕地求生記 第6集 - 與豹同行
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E5 -Hippo / 野性科學 第5集 - 河馬
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africa’s most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial male’s bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E6 -Caiman / 野性科學 第6集 - 美洲鱷
programme.desc: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E5 -Grasslands / 地球演化實錄 第5集 - 草原奧祕
programme.desc: Explore one of Earth’s most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E5 -Creatures Great and Small / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第5集 - 不分大小
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.desc: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Aurora’s cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzie’s game-changing research in jeopardy.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E2 -Chinga the Lion Cub / 野小子 第2集 - 幼獅青加
programme.desc: In South Africa’s Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E3 -Usana the Cheetah Cub / 野小子 第3集 - 小獵豹烏珊娜
programme.desc: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she’s got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who’s honing her survival skills in Brazil’s Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E1 -Summer Cubs / 大貓小世界 第1集 - 夏日幼獅
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E2 -Surviving the Flood / 大貓小世界 第2集 - 洪水倖存記
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.desc: Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP’s lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E6 -Kogelberg / 非洲隱世國度 第6集 - 卡格堡
programme.desc: Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E1 -A Penguin Proposal / 「擬人」動物 第1集 - 企鵝求婚記
programme.desc: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E2 -House Hunting Hermit Crabs / 「擬人」動物 第2集 - 寄居蟹．找個家
programme.desc: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimp’s pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E3 -Meerkat Survival School / 「擬人」動物 第3集 - 狐獴求生學校
programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness’ flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters’ club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E4 -Pirate Birds / 「擬人」動物 第4集 - 偷食鳥
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant’s secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E5 -Lion Daycare / 「擬人」動物 第5集 - 獅子育兒中心
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E6 -Shark Dentist / 「擬人」動物 第6集 - 鯊魚牙醫
programme.desc: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkey’s nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E1 -Earth / 地球演化實錄 第1集 - 地土探秘
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E2 -Islands / 地球演化實錄 第2集 - 多樣島嶼
programme.desc: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E3 -Heat / 地球演化實錄 第3集 - 灼熱地球
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E4 -Ice / 地球演化實錄 第4集 - 冰海之間
programme.desc: Trek to the planet’s quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E5 -Grasslands / 地球演化實錄 第5集 - 草原奧祕
programme.desc: Explore one of Earth’s most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E4 -Family Dynamics / 獅群的法則 第4集 - 家族脈動
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E5 -Einstein Rules / 獅群的法則 第5集 - 愛因斯坦主宰
programme.desc: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn / 驕傲之地：野地回春
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions / 大貓九命 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E1 -Einstein Must Go! / 獅群的法則 第1集 - 愛因斯坦必須離開！
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein’s defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E2 -Adapt Or Die / 獅群的法則 第2集 - 適者生存
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E3 -Hide and Seek / 獅群的法則 第3集 - 捉迷藏戲
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E4 -Family Dynamics / 獅群的法則 第4集 - 家族脈動
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E5 -Einstein Rules / 獅群的法則 第5集 - 愛因斯坦主宰

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E3 -Hide and Seek / 獅群的法則 第3集 - 捉迷藏戲
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E5 -Tragedy Strikes Kakumbi / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第5集 - 卡昆比遭受打擊
programme.desc: Feel your heart race when the Kakumbi tree a leopard who’s been stalking them. Join Julz on a ZCP lion-collaring mission, go fishing with scout Simon, explore mealtime pack hierarchy, and witness a heartbreaking vigil for a badly injured Kakumbi pup.

programme.title: Life's Journey S1E1 -Life Begins / 生命之旅 第1集 - 生命的起點
programme.desc: For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulnerable to attack.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E1 -Lyca the Painted Wolf / 野小子 第1集 - 非洲野犬賴卡
programme.desc: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E2 -Chinga the Lion Cub / 野小子 第2集 - 幼獅青加
programme.desc: In South Africa’s Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E3 -Usana the Cheetah Cub / 野小子 第3集 - 小獵豹烏珊娜
programme.desc: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she’s got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E4 -Chico the Baby Capuchin / 野小子 第4集 - 卷尾猴嬰兒施高
programme.desc: In Brazil’s Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E5 -Ravi the Baby Lion Tailed Macaque / 野小子 第5集 - 年幼獅尾猴華菲
programme.desc: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist / 潛鳥：迷霧中的吶喊
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summer’s soundtrack or go silent forever.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E1 -Chasing Freedom / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第1集 - 追逐自由
programme.desc: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poacher’s snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E2 -Monkey Madness / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第2集 - 失控的猴子
programme.desc: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E3 -The Great Escape / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第3集 - 大逃亡
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E4 -Big Buck Chase / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第4集 - 拯救水羚
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poacher's snare. Meanwhile, the center's resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E5 -Creatures Great and Small / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第5集 - 不分大小
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E1 -The Hungry Leopard / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 餓豹傳說
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E2 -A Leopard's Last Stand / 非洲獵人 第2集 - 背水一戰
programme.desc: A wise, old leopard reigns over the Luangwa Valley in Zambia. She holds her own against lions, but is about to face her most serious challenge - the arrival of a younger, nomadic female leopard. Witness the bitter battle of experience versus vitality.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E4 -The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots / 非洲獵人 第4集 - 斑點幻變的豹
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill S1E1 -The Ghost of the Mountains / 雪豹獵奇 第1集 - 高山之靈
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill S1E2 -To Catch a Legend / 雪豹獵奇 第2集 - 追捕傳奇
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dude’s territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard / 野獸絕地求生記 第6集 - 與豹同行
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S1E1 -Africa's Big Cats / 野生動物明星 第1集 - 非洲大貓
programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E6 -Manzi the Superpack / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第6集 - 超級族群曼齊
programme.desc: Head back to the den with the Kakumbi, who are mourning the loss of two pups. Chance upon a hyena den and a lion pride trying to take down a buffalo, then catch up with the Manzi, who are in a standoff with a leopard and a herd of angry elephants.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms S1E1 -Water Worlds / 歐洲野性王國 第1集 - 水之世界
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms S1E2 -Mountain Worlds / 歐洲野性王國 第2集 - 山之世界
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe’s most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that’s cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn / 驕傲之地：野地回春
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E1 -Raw Power / 超獸 第1集 - 原始力量
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom’s most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E2 -Super Speed / 超獸 第2集 - 超級速度
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth’s fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E1 -Ultimate Predator / 鯊魚星球 第1集 - 終極獵手
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey’s heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E6 -Catch Me if You Can / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第6集 - 來追我
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the team's plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.desc: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

programme.title: Wild Philippines S1E1 -Realm of Volcanoes / 野性菲律賓 第1集 - 火山國度
programme.desc: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the world’s rarest crocodile.

programme.title: Wild Philippines S1E2 -Realm of Jungles / 野性菲律賓 第2集 - 叢林國度
programme.desc: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E2 -Ocean Voyagers / 鯊魚星球 第2集 - 「鯊」海遨遊
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean’s vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E1 -Reef Wrecks of Bonaire / 「礁」來船禍 第1集 - 博奈爾礁石沉船
programme.desc: Bonaire’s fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

programme.title: Great Indian Railway Journeys S1E2 -Jodhpur To Delhi / 印度鐵路紀行 第2集 - 久德浦爾到德里
programme.desc: Bradshaw's 1913 Handbook of Indian, Foreign and Colonial Travel in hand, Michael embarks on a stunning rail journey from the Thar Desert in Rajasthan to the Indian capital, taking in desert landscapes and dazzling historic palaces.

programme.title: Great Indian Railway Journeys S1E3 -Mysuru To Chennai / 印度鐵路紀行 第3集 - 邁索爾到清奈
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Bradshaw's 1913 Handbook of Indian, Foreign and Colonial Travel leads him on railway journey through the modern south Indian states of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, from the former princely state of Mysore to the first stronghold of the East India Company in Chennai, formerly Madras.

programme.title: Great Indian Railway Journeys S1E4 -Lucknow To Kolkata / 印度鐵路紀行 第4集 - 勒克瑙到加爾各答
programme.desc: On an epic railway journey from Lucknow in Uttar Pradesh to Kolkata in West Bengal, Michael Portillo uses his Bradshaw's 1913 Handbook of Indian, Foreign and Colonial Travel, published when the British Raj was fifty-five years old, to chart a course through India's history from the days of The East India Company to the dawn of independence.

programme.title: Feral S1E7 -Chinese Mystery Snails / Feral 第7集 - Chinese Mystery Snails
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral S1E8 -Axis Deer / Feral 第8集 - Axis Deer
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife S1E1 / Malaysian Wildlife 第1集
programme.desc:
Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals.
The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E5 -Rhino / Extreme Animal Transport 第5集 - Rhino
programme.desc: At 9 years of age Kifaru is already a well-travelled Southern White Rhino. He was born in New Zealand at Hamilton Zoo as part of their Rhino breeding programmed. Then in 2014, at five years of age, he was moved across the Tasman Sea to Australia to the National Zoo and Aquarium. After four years in the country’s capital zoo, it’s time for him to move again. This time, getting him into the transportation crate is not easy but the team are ready with plans A – Z.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E6 -Elephants Pt1 African Elephants / Extreme Animal Transport 第6集 - Elephants Pt1 African Elephants
programme.desc: Derek Milburn runs NGO Elephants Rhinos and People, which, over the course of a year will transport 250 elephants from South Africa to Mozambique via road. The current location of the herd is getting overcrowded which could eventually be dangerous to both elephants and people in surrounding villages. This first mission will involve 25-30 elephants the number will vary depending on how many ERP’s team find in the herd. Day one of the mission and the trucks get stuck in mud before reaching the elephants. A helicopter flies above darting the herd with a tranquilizer. They must dart the females first, to ensure the rest of the herd stay, darting a male accidentally means the herd could split and be lost altogether. They must be careful not to leave one of the family behind, this would mean disaster for the abandoned animal. The elephants are then lifted upside down with a helicopter onto their crates. programme.desc:
Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals.
The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. programme.title: Feral S1E5 -Rusty Crayfish / Feral 第5集 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: Feral S1E6 -Common Carp / Feral 第6集 - Common Carp
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Feral S1E7 -Chinese Mystery Snails / Feral 第7集 - Chinese Mystery Snails
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral S1E8 -Axis Deer / Feral 第8集 - Axis Deer
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E3 -Lions Pt 1 / Extreme Animal Transport 第3集 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E4 -Lions Pt 2 / Extreme Animal Transport 第4集 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. It’s a temporary holding facility while Four Paws find a long-term sanctuary equipped to care for a lion in his condition as he will need specialized care and pain medication for the time that he lives.He’s about to make the journey to his forever home. After weeks of crate training the veterinarians who specialize in large animal transports Marc and Juno are relieved that Ivan- Asen doesn’t need to be tranquilized to be moved into the crate. The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.title: Feral S1E5 -Rusty Crayfish / Feral 第5集 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: Feral S1E6 -Common Carp / Feral 第6集 - Common Carp
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Feral S1E7 -Chinese Mystery Snails / Feral 第7集 - Chinese Mystery Snails
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral S1E8 -Axis Deer / Feral 第8集 - Axis Deer
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E3 -Lions Pt 1 / Extreme Animal Transport 第3集 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. Moving the national animal of Bulgaria across international borders is something powers high up a

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E4 -Lions Pt 2 / Extreme Animal Transport 第4集 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. It’s a temporary holding facility while Four Paws find a long-term sanctuary equipped to care for a lion in his condition as he will need specialized care and pain medication for the time that he lives.He’s about to make the journey to his forever home. programme.desc: The northern region of Western Australia is one of the most remote regions in the world, where the red landscape unfolds endlessly towards the horizon. programme.title: Experience Australia S1E10 -Southern Western Australia / Experience Australia 第10集 - Southern Western Australia
programme.desc: From the towering Karri forests of Warren National Park to the ancient rock formations of The Pinnacles, Western Australia’s southern region is a treasure of natural wonders. In the final installment of Experience Australia, we highlight the best experiences for visitors to this magical region. Explore the pristine coastline and cuddly wildlife residents of Rottnest Island, immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural experience at Yanchep National Park, and embark on a thrilling sea voyage to encounter the elusive killer whale.

programme.desc: After capturing and loading 30 African Elephants into their transport crates, the convoy is finally ready for the long journey ahead. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E8 -Air Horse One / Extreme Animal Transport 第8集 - Air Horse One
programme.desc: A variety of Australian horses are purchased from Singapore investors and annually a cargo plane with up to 50 horses are flown from Sydney Airport to Manilla Airport. The horses range from race horses to miniature ponies to Clydesdales. A mission like this takes meticulous planning. Cameron from Equine International Airfreight won’t let one piece of incorrect paperwork stall his mission. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The final veterinary checks are undertaken by a government vet at quarantine and the horses are washed prior to the trip. The first leg of the journey is a one-hour drive on a convoy of four semi-trailers moving from quarantine to the airport. programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.desc: After capturing and loading 30 African Elephants into their transport crates, the convoy is finally ready for the long journey ahead. However, a late departure and unexpected delays at the borders means they could be facing offloading the elephants under only the light of the moon. Not ideal for the exhausted drivers and the wild elephants who are ready to get out of their transportation crates and explore their new home.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E8 -Air Horse One / Extreme Animal Transport 第8集 - Air Horse One
programme.desc: A variety of Australian horses are purchased from Singapore investors and annually a cargo plane with up to 50 horses are flown from Sydney Airport to Manilla Airport. The horses range from race horses to miniature ponies to Clydesdales. A mission like this takes meticulous planning. Cameron from Equine International Airfreight won’t let one piece of incorrect paperwork stall his mission. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The first leg of the journey is a one-hour drive on a convoy of four semi-trailers moving from quarantine to the airport. programme.title: The World:2026 E45 / The World 第45集
programme.desc: There's never been a more important time to stay in touch with what's happening in our world. Manny Tsigas presents the latest international news from ABC News correspondents as well as interviews with experts and guests.

programme.title: Gardening Australia:2026 E13 -South Coast Of New South Wales / Gardening Australia 第13集 - South Coast Of New South Wales
programme.desc: Costa and Clarence take a trip to the South Coast of NSW. They visit a coastal garden, learn about local bushfood, and explore an alternative to traditional burial. Costa visits a community garden on a disused bowling green.

programme.title: Alone Australia S3E6 / Alone Australia 第6集
programme.desc: Food is in extraordinary abundance for some survivalists, while others struggle with empty bellies and question their future in the competition.

Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: Vf S9E67 -Bluemarble, Anthony Alvarez (Autumn-Winter 2023) / Vf 第67集 - Bluemarble, Anthony Alvarez (Autumn-Winter 2023)

programme.desc: In Seine-Maritime, David Gallienne explores asparagus farming. With chef Melanie, they prepare a green asparagus and hazelnut tartare, topped with a white asparagus veloute and a poached egg.

programme.title: Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature:2021-2022 E10 -The Durance Valley / Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature 第10集 - The Durance Valley

programme.title: Les Cueilleurs S1E5 -Dune Pepper / Les Cueilleurs 第5集 - Dune Pepper
programme.desc: In Riviere-Saint-Jean, Alex Beaudin and Alexis Parisee are preparing their snowmobile for an expedition into the forest. Here in the Cote-Nord, with the thermometer registering -17°C, the two childhood friends set off to collect dune pepper. This unique spice is used equally in cooking meat or preparing gin and beer.

programme.title: Cuisine Ouverte:2024-2025 E27 -At Castellet, With Louise Aubery / Cuisine Ouverte 第27集 - At Castellet, With Louise Aubery
programme.desc: Mory Sacko is at Castellet with content creator Louise Aubery. Today's menu: 'dumpling' ravioli with Rove goat cheese.

programme.title: Tendance XXI S11E20 -Special Artistic Crafts / Tendance XXI 第20集 - Special Artistic Crafts
programme.desc: This tour of France of the artisans begins in the Grand-Est region. After Longwy, off to Mirecourt and Baccarat! In Occitanie, visit Revel, Martres-Tolosane and Pezenas. In Normandy, from Mont-Saint-Michel to Alencon, brassware shines, lace enchants and craftsmen continue to pass on their skills.

programme.title: Les Routes Du Gout S1E4 -Emma And Alain's Walk / Les Routes Du Gout 第4集 - Emma And Alain's Walk
programme.desc: Michelin-starred chef Alain Llorca, at the head of the restaurant bearing the chef's name, guides a gastronomic route between La Colle-sur-Loup, Nice, Saint-Paul-de-Vence and Tourrettes-sur-Loup. Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programme.title: Mon Plus Beau Village S6E3 -Isabelle Hauben In Sprimont / Mon Plus Beau Village 第3集 - Isabelle Hauben In Sprimont
programme.desc: The Liege comedian Isabelle Hauben presents Sprimont, in the former province of the Prince-Bishops. On the program, mechanics, a bit of smoke and lots of laughter... To accompany her on this journey, she is joined by David Jeanmotte. Hold on tight!

programme.title: Vroum:2022-2023 E15 -Caen Heritage / Vroum 第15集 - Caen Heritage
programme.desc: In Aunay-sur-Odon, Michel rides in Benjamin's 2 CV. Benjamin is a young mechanic working in a workshop specialized in maintaining these cars. Laurent talks with the president of the Deudeuch Club of Caen.

programme.title: Les Saisons De Pique-Assiette S15E14 -Looking Ahead To Summer: Shakshuka / Les Saisons De Pique-Assiette 第14集 - Looking Ahead To Summer: Shakshuka
programme.desc: Accompanied by Brigitte Rosset, Annick Jeanmairet prepares a shakshuka, a kind of tomato and pepper compote with eggs and herbs, and eggplants prepared like stuffed tomatoes. Discovery of the day: the art of table service, alongside a champion who works at Domaine de Chateauvieux.

programme.title: Des Racines & Des Ailes:2025 E7 -Burgundy, Land Of Passions / Des Racines & Des Ailes 第7集 - Burgundy, Land Of Passions
programme.desc: Burgundy holds thousand-year-old treasures: among others, the abbeys of Fontenay and Citeaux and the Chateau du Clos-Vougeot, listed as UNESCO World Heritage sites. A unique heritage that continues to inspire enthusiasts who fight to keep it alive and highlight it.

programme.title: C'est Du Belge:2025-2026 E18 -When Belgium Sets The Tone / C'est Du Belge 第18集 - When Belgium Sets The Tone
programme.desc: Fifty years of career for Jean-Luc Fonck who, with his band Sttellla, has never stopped daring, amusing and surprising; the opening of the largest tropical greenhouse in the world at Pairi Daiza; the final rehearsals of Alex Vizorek's musical, with Alice on the Roof and Mustii.

programme.title: Bien Bati S1E2 -Churches With New Community Roles / Bien Bati 第2集 - Churches With New Community Roles
programme.desc: In Sainte-Foy, St-Denys-du-Plateau church has become Monique-Corriveau library. On Kitcisakik peninsula, the church and the wooden huts are still used by the community. And we discover the profession as tinsmith and roofer.
