programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: Gangsters Sagar and Uday decide to abandon crime, but their plans falter when they struggle to find a suitable groom for their sister, tempting them to return to their old ways. Release Year: 2015 Director: Anees Bazmee Awards: 2016 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award- The 100 Crore Club

programme.title: A Thursday
programme.desc: One fateful Thursday in the city of Mumbai invites tremendous horror when Naina, a nursery school teacher, holds 16 children hostage and produces a list of unfathomable demands. Release Year: 2022 Director: Behzad Khambata Awards: 2022 Nominee Popular Award - Best Web Original Film, 2022 Winner Digital Movies and TV Series AwardBest Digital Content - Long Format

programme.title: Bayama Irukku
programme.desc: A man rescues four friends and gives them shelter in his home. However, they soon realise that the man's wife is actually a ghost and decide to help him.

programme.title: Pyaar Impossible
programme.desc: Alisha is popular, while Abhay is a geek who loves her from afar. Years later, their paths cross, and Abhay cares for Alisha's daughter. He uses this chance to become her ideal man. Release Year: 2010 Director: Jugal Hansraj

programme.title: Visfot
programme.desc: A Mumbai slum family's cramped life contrasts a rich high-rise family's luxury until their lives fatefully intersect one day.A Mumbai slum family's cramped. Release Year: 2024 Director: Kookie Gulati

programme.title: Ms Dhoni - The Untold Story
programme.desc: A boy from Ranchi, M S Dhoni, decides to pursue his dream of playing cricket for India despite initially working for the Indian Railways to please his father.

programme.title: Deewana Mastana
programme.desc: Neha, a psychiatrist, is pursued by both Raja, a small-time crook, and Bunnu, a patient. Things take a hilarious turn when the two try to outsmart each other to win Neha's heart. Release Year: 1997 Director: David Dhawan Awards: Filmfare Award- Best Comedian/Comedienne- Johnny Lever

programme.title: Chandni Chowk To China
programme.desc: A simple cook is mistaken for the reincarnation of an ancient warrior Liu Shengh by residents of an oppressed Chinese village. Release Year: 2009 Director: Nikkhil Advani

programme.title: Kyo Kii Main Jhuth Nahi Bolta
programme.desc: Raj is a lawyer who finds great success through his habit of lying. However, when his son wishes for his father to stop lying, Raj is magically forced to speak the truth and gets into trouble. Release Year: 2001 Director: David Dhawan

programme.title: Pathaan
programme.desc: An Indian RAW agent named Pathaan discovers a planned attack on India led by a mercenary group, and must team up with an ally to stop them while facing numerous betrayals and destruction. Release Year: 2023 Director: Siddharth Anand Awards: 2023 Winner Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award - Favorite Movie, 2023 Nominee IFF Award - Best Film

programme.title: Awara Paagal Deewana
programme.desc: Dr Anmol, a henpecked dentist in New York, suffers under his domineering wife. His miserable life turns chaotic when he unknowingly gets caught in a dangerous mafia rivalry. Release Year: 2002 Director: Vikram Bhatt

programme.title: Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior
programme.desc: Tanhaji, a Maratha warrior, is Shivaji Maharaj's trusted lieutenant. When the Mughals invade and conquer Kondhana fort, he sets out to reclaim it for his king and country. Release Year: 2020 Director: Om Raut Awards: 2022 Winner Golden Lotus Award - Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment, 2021 Nominee Filmfare Award - Best Film, 2021 Nominee Film Award - Best Film, 2020 Nominee Masala Readers' Choice Award - Best Film

programme.title: Coolie: The Powerhouse
programme.desc: Deva learns his friend Rajshekar was murdered and discovers a chair that turns bodies to ash. With Preeti, he exposes smuggling ring and seeks justice.

programme.title: Mantostaan
programme.desc: Mantostaan is a dark satire based on four controversial short stories of the legendary Urdu writer Saadat Hasan Manto. Mantostaan sheds light on the inhumane side of mankind. Release Year: 2017 Director: Rahat Kazmi

programme.title: Action Replayy
programme.desc: Fed-up with his parents constantly fighting, a young boy goes back in time to make his parents fall in love. This leads to hilarious situations. Release Year: 2010 Director: Vipul Amrutlal Shah Awards: 2011 Nominee Dainik Bhaskar Bollywood Award- Jodi of the Year- Akshay Kumar, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan

programme.title: Rajini The Jailer
programme.desc: Muthuvel Pandian, a stern yet compassionate jailer, sets out to stop a gang when they try to flee their leader from prison.

programme.title: Dil Bechara
programme.desc: Dil Bechara

programme.title: Dhol
programme.desc: Four friends set out in their individual plans to marry wealthy Ritu Tanushree. Their plan however goes horribly wrong after they get embroiled with a notorious criminal. Release Year: 2007 Director: Priyadarshan, Aman Ullah

programme.title: Aunty No. 1
programme.desc: When Gopi is asked to pretend to his friend Aunt, he doesn't realize the mess he will get into when the real Aunt shows up. Release Year: 1998 Director: Kirti Kumar Awards: 2 nominations

programme.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
programme.desc: The younger son of a rich couple sets out in search of his elder brother who was disowned for marrying below their status. Release Year: 2001 Director: Karan Johar

programme.title: Jo Tera Hai Who Mera Hai
programme.desc: Mitesh, a poor tea vendor, plans to trick an old man. But as his scheme falls apart, unexpected connections change his life, leading him to understand the true meaning of family. Release Year: 2024 Director: Raj Trivedi

programme.title: Dillagi
programme.desc: Unaware that his brother is in love with the girl he himself loves, Ranvir arranges for their wedding. Release Year: 1999 Director: Sunny Deol

programme.title: Ram Avtar
programme.desc: Childhood friends Ram and Avtar. Ram goes abroad to study. Avtar loves Sangeeta, but she loves Ram. Ram sacrifices his love for Avtar. An enemy threatens to expose the truth. Release Year: 1988 Director: Sunil Hingorani

programme.title: Hello Brother
programme.desc: A police officer gets a heart transplant from a murder victim. The victim's spirit guides him to uncover the truth and seek justice for the unsolved crime. Release Year: 1999 Director: Sohail Khan Awards: 1 Bollywood Movie Awards.

programme.title: Heer Ranjha
programme.desc: Heer, from a wealthy family, and Ranjha, a poor farm boy, fall deeply in love. Their world shatters when Heer's parents force her into marriage with a rich suitor. Release Year: 1992 Director: Harmesh Malhotra

programme.title: What The Fish
programme.desc: Sudha hands over the responsibility of her house and pet fish to her niece's fiance before leaving for a holiday. When she returns, all seems fine until she opens the bathroom door. Release Year: 2013 Director: Gurmmeet Singh

programme.title: Dhoom 2
programme.desc: Mr. A, a daring thief, steals priceless artifacts and partners with a woman he likes but distrusts. Meanwhile, three relentless police officers chase them, leading to a high-stakes pursuit.
